content: Lakkhi Halwai has been running his sweet shop on MG Road, Bihar, for over 30 years. He keeps his business simple by focusing on a limited product portfolio. The business primarily generates revenue from two products: Kachori, which has a lower profit margin and contributes approximately 60% of the revenue, and Jalebi, which has a higher profit margin and contributes approximately 40% of the revenue. Despite charging premium prices compared to nearby competitors, Lakkhi has built a loyal customer base through consistent quality, strong customer trust, and decades of goodwill.
